owner.name: Dylan
owner.headline: I build AI pilots the way a forward deployed engineer would: start from a real business problem, ship a working system, and measure what changed.
owner.about: CS graduate from Virginia Tech. Previously a data science contractor on Kenvue's Consumer Business Intelligence team, building Amazon marketplace optimization models. Now working full time toward forward deployed engineering, one pilot at a time.

pilots.title: Example pilot: support ticket triage
pilots.problem: Agents spend the first minutes of every ticket figuring out where it should go.
pilots.built: A classifier that reads the ticket, picks a queue, and drafts a first reply for the agent to edit.
